notes.title: Halloween Update, Dev News #6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/e561bf5326afd8380146fc9138e70a9d12548176.png[/img]

[b]Hey there![/b]

We know it's been a while, but we're back with some exciting news!

We've made some spooky changes to the demo, adding in some Halloween decorations that will be around from October 25th to November 3rd. This update doesn't include any bug fixes or gameplay changes, as we're currently laser-focused on crafting levels and finishing other stuff for the Early Access release.

And based on your awesome suggestions, we've also given Dog a more meaningful role in the game. Yes, you will be able to play as Dog in EA release.

Check these awesome GIFs out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/5164113fc70e0e2056e1fdc9fa865d2c03a97d91.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/ade5e20767e819fc593a92e2d400439ba5bc371e.gif[/img]

[b]Happy Halloween! Stay tuned.[/b]

notes.title: Holo Girls, Bunny Hop Update #4
notes.content:
Hello dear fans of reptiloid battles! Today we are pleased to present you with a fresh update to the BRUTAL JOHN demo!

In this update, we spent a whole month paying attention to your feedback, most of the suggestions were very hard to implement, but we hope it was worth it!

1. We paid a lot of attention to the crosshair, we made it highly customizable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/9d7bdfbcb4ee55991ef5203b49fadca2dd3a5062.png[/img]

2. The most important change is that we have completely overhauled the player movement system. We were constantly getting reports of issues with steering, heavy platforming and jolting while walking and have devoted the most time to addressing this issue in this update.

In addition to a completely revamped player movement system - we've added the ability to do sliding and bunnyhops, we've made these two mechanics complementary (a slide will allow you to maintain speed) so that you get the most out of your movement. In the future, we will pay even more attention to the movement system.

3. And among other things - we put neon strippers that will dance for you on the rooftops of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/ae9f7ee3ac251907727243b77e88410c3c07301d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/cc28c45e59d88a882b509224dcbe28c95210b439.png[/img]

Enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Demolition Update (New Demo Level) #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/0264ab942d0b25e93801632433f4068718882b4b.png[/img]

Dear players, we are glad to present you a new update of Brutal John demo, which significantly expands the number of destructible objects, additional new level elements, weapon upgrades, improves of the game optimization, fixes of huge number of bugs and new cutscenes.

As a bonus for your attention to the game - we have added a new, third demo level: Train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/2747ae42d0e7e91983ddd744df57d53037dd60d0.jpg[/img]

In this major update we have paid a lot of attention to many decorations, making them destructible, so the game will be much more fun for you. We've also added an in-game "Super Shop", where you can spend the money you find as you progress through the game. In this "Super Shop", you can buy additional attacks for some weapons, like flamethrower or plasma beam, as well as some other items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/a8cc8db090677fdcabf741fb75f2d9aaab7624a5.jpg[/img]

Also, we paid a lot of attention to optimizing the game and fixing bugs. AI of enemies has been slightly improved, so that fighting even with short-range enemies at a distance will create some challenge for you. We've balanced the gameplay a bit, and also added a new type of enemies - Pig Cops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/02d01c26e706055f9bc3153cc588b374c63dc9a3.jpg[/img]

We regularly read your feedback to make the game better and better.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Demo Update and Development News #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/c913377f11f9f8cafab1abd7dde342d1fda417bd.png[/img]

[b]Hello dear players! Happy New Year! We would like to present you with a big update to the demo version.[/b]

In this update, we took into account most of the feedback and did a lot of work on bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290948/d3accefb78ae04e208a1588a11f126eca7bc1602.png[/img]

One of the key additions in the updated version is new enemy animations. In addition to updated animations, enemy weapon models have been updated, and game performance has also been improved.
Slight graphics improvements have also been incorporated into this update.

Rest assured that we are committed to providing the best possible experience for our players by continuing to refine and improve the game as we approach launch.

Enemies will continue to improve according to our capabilities. We work hard on the game almost every day.

Enjoy demo update, and stay tuned!

notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
We have succesfully updated demo build according to community feedback!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Movement is polished, now it does not feel like on the moon.
[*] We did optimization pass, game works much better now.
[*] Enemy sounds are redone, sounds much better now.
[*] More options in Settings menu.
[*] Art was polished, better textures for enemies, props, etc.
[*] Bugfixes.
[/list]

Thanks for the support and feedback!

[b]SPECIAL DEMO IS COMING FOR STEAM NEXT FEST! STAY TUNED![/b]
